notes.title: 1.0.5 - The controls update
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/m4MmNr3.gif[/img]

Changelog
[list]
[*]New aiming action.
-When you click a target with the right mouse button while equipping a firearm, it will aim a target. While aiming, goon will follow the target and keep the firearm pointed at it.
-You need to first aim a target before you can shoot it. This does not apply to melee weapons.
-You can now also drag from a character and end your dragging on top of a target to start aiming at it.
[*]Added lines from goon to target to indicate the action you are about to execute.
[*]Q is now always mapped to fists(holster weapon).
[*]E,R,T are now always mapped to weapons in order of your inventory.
[*]Inventory quick select keys(Q,E,R,T) do not toggle between equip and unequip anymore, they only equip target weapon. This should make controlling a group and using quick keys easier.
[*]Updated controls reference screen.
[*]If you have completed an objective, it will now be properly shown as completed when you go to a heist for a subsequent time.
[*]Added source assets as an example for modders.
[*]Fixed a crash that was happening if a font or a sprite was not found from a spritesheet.
[*]Support for French and German characters in fonts
[*]Unique icon for improvised explosive
[*]Fixed overlapping doors in bank and arcade
[*]Added "staff only" signs to some off-limits areas
[/list]

Here's a small teaser for the next update:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/xfsCWmD.png[/img]

[i]P.S. If you are interested in joining a test group of map makers/modders for The Masterplan, follow The Masterplan on Steam, and email us at info@sharkpunch.com. Include your Steam forum username, so we can add you to the testing group.[/i]

notes.title: The Masterplan 1.0.2 update now available!
notes.content:
Week since the release and we've been listening to the feedback you guys have given and made an update to the most recent issues found.

We'd like to thank our whole community for reporting the issues that you've found which we've missed ourselves, so we can make The Masterplan a better game for all.

Changelog

[b]1.0.2[/b][i]
- Fixed a "Null Object Reference" crash caused by the field of view system.
- Melee attacks don't use projectiles any more to cause damage. Damage is caused instantly to the correct target.
- All characters can now walk through each other and your own characters do not even try to avoid each other when pathfinding.
- Fixed an issue where clerks, customers and guards would not get aggressive/panic when witnessing suspicious activity if the police have been called.
- Added flag "-textureQuality=number" where number can be 1, 2, 3, 4. Default is 4 and that's the max. Minimum is 1. Reduces texture memory usage and might be worth a try if you have trouble booting up the game or entering a level.
- Reduced the number of memory allocations during runtime, reducing the amount of memory the game leaks and thus reduced the amount of memory related crashes.
- Fixed an issue where an item could not be picked up if too close to a static obstacle, such as a table.
- Fixed an issue where an additional horse mask would appear on the Horseplay if the horse guy had been killed previously.
- Fixed pathfinding issues caused by path nodes appearing on too narrow places, such as near the counter on Minimart.
- Fixed the character movement mode getting stuck if a user issued mouse up and mouse down events on the same frame(was happening often when playing with a touchpad).
- Fixed the issue where a locked grouped door(A) couldn't be unlocked after locking the group's other door(B) while the other door(A) was wide open.
- Removed "Powered" text from circuits.
- Safecracker can now be unlocked and bought from store.
- Changed the sound effects from breaking walls.
- Fixed groups in some double doors to lock/unlock with a single action.
- Changed the inaccessible area behind the front desk in Police Station.
- Fixed Jewelry Store spawning old items on top of jewelry displays.
- Removed phone from Suspicious Alley.
- Added extra empty space around Jewelry Store.
- Changed Hideout table collider sizes.[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/C3wj0GL.gif[/img]
[i]A certain review said that the game has pixel art. Changing the texture quality settings that is now actually possible.[/i]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE 8.1 - Tuna Hotfix
notes.content:
Following quickly on the heels of yesterday's 8.0 release, the Early Access Update 8.1 addresses the main issues with the new campaign mode, along with some immediate bug fixes.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
-Fixed the 'Tuna Bug' that caused a crash when going back to Minimart (or Arcade) if you hadn't stolen the tuna and the candy. Yeah, you read that right.
-Fixed a bug that crashed the game when loading the bonus multiplayer levels. 
-When your whole team dies in a level, you can't accidentally go back to hideout anymore, you must reset the heist (instead of having a chance to go back to the hideout without goons.)
-Respawning ammo/weapons added to some levels, including the hideout.
-Hideout gets respawnable weapons after you've found the item one time. (This will change when we get the "Black Market" implemented where you can actually buy weapons and ammo.)
-Gregory Green starts with a pistol and some ammo now.
-You can now open the 'Hire Goons' menu with right-clicking as well as left-clicking.

notes.title: WE'RE DONATING 10% OF NOVEMBER REVENUE TO THE MOVEMBER FOUNDATION. JOIN OUR MOTEAM!
notes.content:
[i]We're big supporters of [url=http://us.movember.com/en/mospace/team/1671377/?id=1671377]Movember[/url], and since The Masterplan is pretty moustache-heavy, we figured now would be a good opportunity to do some good while playing games and growing awesome 'staches.[/i]

Therefore, [b]we're donating 10% of our November early access revenue to the Movember foundation![/b] Our goal is to raise awareness of men's health issues, especially in the game developer and gaming enthusiast communities.

[h1]How to participate[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=http://us.movember.com/en/mospace/team/1671377/?id=1671377]Join our Moteam[/url]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/313080]Buy the game![/url]
[*]Spread the word!
[*]Grow a 'stache.
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/2Kasieo.gif[/img]

Press release below...

[h1]Indie game studio pledges to donate 10% of revenue to the Movember Foundation[/h1]

[i]San Francisco and Helsinki, October 31st – Shark Punch, the developer of the 70s heist game The Masterplan, pledges to donate 10% of November revenue to the Movember Foundation[/i]

"The Masterplan is a game about moustaches", says Shark Punch CEO Jiri Kupiainen. "Visualize the protagonist of a great 70s crime movie. I guarantee an awesome moustache is one of the first things to come to mind."

Shark Punch is an independent game development studio founded by veterans of the Finnish games industry. The Early Access version of their first game The Masterplan has been available on Steam Early Access since September. The company is pledging to donate 10% of their early access revenue in November to the Movember Foundation.

The company says their primary reason for doing this is to raise awareness of men's health issues especially in the game developer community. "The games industry is rapidly diversifying, which is the best thing ever. However, today still over three quarters of game developers are men. And based on my 14 years of experience in the industry, most of us men could pay more attention to our personal health."

Shark Punch wants to remind fellow game developers to maintain good work-life balance, exercise regularly, and not to skip their health checkups. "We wish more people saw their career in games as a multi-decade commitment, instead of five years of crunching, bad habits and eventual burnout. Stay healthy and keep making games! After all, it's probably the best job anyone could have." Kupiainen says.

The company has set up a Moteam page for The Masterplan, and invites all fans of the game, the studio, or men's health in general to join up and donate. Four fifths of the company are participating in Movember, the sole exception being the creative director, who claims not to be able to grow a moustache. The rest of the team testifies this to be true.

[h1]About The Masterplan[/h1]
The Masterplan is a tactical action puzzler about bank robberies in the 70s. The game is now available on Steam Early Access for Windows, Mac and Linux.

[h1]About Shark Punch[/h1]

Shark Punch was founded by Jiri Kupiainen, Leo Lännenmäki, Aarne Hunziker and Harri Manninen. We are based in San Francisco, California and Helsinki, Finland.

Movember Team Page: http://us.movember.com/en/mospace/team/1671377/?id=1671377 The Masterplan Website: http://themasterplangame.com
Shark Punch Website: http://sharkpunch.com/

notes.title: UPDATE: Early Access Build 2.0 - RELEASE NOTES - ADDED LINUX SUPPORT!
notes.content:
Happy to announce the first update for The Masterplan! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/PykcEX9.png[/IMG]

We've added [b]a new heist scenario ("The Bar")[/b] and [b]fixed a ton of issues[/b].

We've also added LINUX SUPPORT!

We've had limited time to test various Linux configurations so a word of warning, you may run into issues, but make sure you report them and we'll get them fixed asap.

[h1]New Content and Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now available on Linux!
[*]...testing on Linux has been limited, so standard Early Access warnings apply - If you run into issues, please report them on our forums or via email to support (at) sharkpunch.com
[*]New Heist: "The Bar"
[*]Improved framerate across all platforms
[*]New map screen background
[*]Improved aiming & direction - You can now issue a direction where your goon will face by keeping right mouse button pressed and dragging away from issued waypoint
[/list]

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/KyKeoBv.gif[/IMG]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Only show equip hot key for currently actionable items. For example, don't show hot key for ammo
[*]Stop attacking if weapon is changed to a different type weapon. For example you have issued a melee command and then decide to intimidate instead and equip a gun, the character will not shoot
[*]ZZZzz effect is only shown for unconscious bodies and the effect moves with the body if the body is moved to another spot
[*]Disallow issuing commands beyond level bounds
[*]Fix NPCs sometimes getting stuck facing the opposite direction they are going
[*]Centering camera on a goon only works when quickly selecting the same goon twice. For example, if you quickly press "1" twice, it will select the first goon and then center the camera on it.
[*]Bodies are only counted once towards the bodycount. Previously picking up and dropping bodies increased the bodycount.
[*]Fix loot count and ammo count texts sometimes displaying incorrect amounts
[*]Fixed goons sometimes picking up items from a super far
[*]Fixed guards and cops not being able to walk through broken windows
[*]Fixed items getting heavier and heavier if they were picked up and dropped multiple times
[*]Fixed picked up and then dropped items sometimes getting permanent "Pickup"-tooltips
[*]Fixed lots of issues with game crashing when pressing "New Game". If the game still crashes, see workarounds (http://steamcommunity.com/app/313080/discussions/2/613936039655729769/) or contact us via email support@sharkpunch.com
[/list]
Enjoy the update! Thanks for your support and be sure to tell your friends about The Masterplan! Stay tuned for another update in a couple of weeks!

notes.title: Early Access Now Available!
notes.content:
The Masterplan is available today on Early Access! Read here on what to expect.

The Masterplan is still very much under development, and you can expect the game to evolve a lot during the next months according to the community's feedback.

[b]What can I expect in this Early Access version?[/b]
[list]
[*]Fully playable
[*]Provides 1.5-2 hours worth of playtime
[*]Collection of several levels/heist locations to play through and experiment 
[*]Expect some challenges
[*]Balancing will be adjusted according to your feedback
[*]In-game money is used to unlock heist locations
[*]In future updates, loot can be used to purchase weapons, intel and other perks to progress in the game
[*]Goons will gain specialized skills in later updates
[*]Includes experimental game play mode "It Came From the Vault" that was done during Ludum Dare 30, which you cannot actually win because there is no escape from hell.
[/list]
[b]Updates[/b]
We are planning to update the game every two weeks. Updates will feature more content, more features, bug fixes and balancing out gameplay.

[b]What can I expect in the full version?[/b]
The full version will have a full story driven campaign. The Early Access version is more a collection of levels, since we don't want to ruin the story for anyone. We will adjust the feature roadmap according to community feedback, naturally.

[b]How long will the game stay on Early Access?[/b]
We're planning on launching the full version in Spring 2015.

Thanks and enjoy playing! Looking forward to your feedback!
